summary: Approved. The CLI matches the applicable contract: exactly one path is required; UTF-8 file-read failures produce a useful stderr diagnostic and exit 2; parsing/summarization/rendering are invoked after a successful read; invalid records still produce a report and exit 1, while valid or empty input exits 0. Static imports are outside the read-error handler, so module import failures are not misreported as input errors. The subprocess tests exercise normal, empty, mixed-validity, argument-count, and unreadable-path behavior. No substantive defects found.
